headline: Texans complete trade with Cardinals for WR Marvin Harrison Jr.
summary: The Texans have completed a trade for Cardinals wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr., coach DeMeco Ryans told reporters.

headline: Jefferson, Jones and Murray all produce to help the unbeaten Vikings top the slumping Saints 23-13

headline: Love-Watson connection helps Packers take some revenge on Bears with a 31-7 rout
summary: — Christian Watson caught two long touchdown passes from Jordan Love, MarShawn Lloyd also scored twice and the Green Bay Packers exacted a measure of revenge against the Chicago Bears by trouncing them 31-7 on Sunday.

headline: Jaguars' emergency long snapper plays unlikely hero in win over Eagles
summary: Jaguars nose tackle DaVon Hamilton delivered the crucial snap on Cam Little's game-winning 57-yard field goal.

headline: Allen has late 22-yard TD run and Jets' defense, special teams come up big in 17-12 win over Browns
summary: — Braelon Allen ran 22 yards for the go-ahead touchdown late in the fourth quarter after New York recovered a fumbled punt snap and the Jets ended a three-game skid with a 17-12 victory over the Cleveland Browns on a rain-soaked Sunday.
